about: Memory retrieval set for knowledge.query (scripts/bench_memory.py). 48 fictional facts: 12 subjects with 4 attributes each, so a query that names its subject still has to pick the right attribute among that subject's facts. Query classes: near = the fact's own vocabulary, inflected or reordered; para = the same question in other words (the subject is named, the predicate is not); noname = a description that does not name the subject; topic = the subject's name alone (every fact about it should come back, and nothing else); none = a question about something that is not in memory (the right result is nothing). Gold ids name facts as <subject>.<attribute>. The first six subjects (orbix to railway) are the development half, on which any threshold is chosen; the last six are held out.

facts.fennick.kind: Fennick is an incremental build tool for polyglot repositories.
facts.fennick.cache: Fennick caches build outputs in a content-addressed store.
facts.fennick.cadence: The Fennick maintainers publish a new release every six weeks.
facts.fennick.memory: Fennick requires at least 4 GB of memory to build large workspaces.
facts.kestrel.creator: Kestrel is a statically typed programming language created by Ilse Marten in 2019.
facts.kestrel.backend: The Kestrel compiler produces native binaries through an LLVM backend.
facts.kestrel.memory: Kestrel manages memory with reference counting instead of a garbage collector.
facts.kestrel.registry: The Kestrel package registry is called Aerie.
facts.dam.height: Standing 186 metres tall, the Brightwater dam remains the tallest structure in the Ostra region.
facts.dam.completed: The Brightwater dam was completed in 1968 after nine years of construction.
facts.dam.reservoir: The reservoir behind the Brightwater dam holds 2.4 cubic kilometres of water.
facts.dam.power: The Brightwater dam generates 740 megawatts of electricity at full capacity.
facts.lighthouse.built: The Tolvane Lighthouse was built in 1874 by the Ostra Harbour Board.
facts.lighthouse.range: The lamp of the Tolvane Lighthouse is visible from 22 nautical miles.
facts.lighthouse.automated: The Tolvane Lighthouse was automated in 1983 and has had no keeper since.
facts.lighthouse.steps: Visitors climb 214 steps to reach the gallery of the Tolvane Lighthouse.
facts.railway.route: The Marrow Valley railway runs 87 kilometres between Hesket and Pell.
facts.railway.closed: Passenger service on the Marrow Valley railway ended in 1971.
facts.railway.gauge: The Marrow Valley railway uses a narrow gauge of 760 millimetres.
facts.railway.gradient: The steepest gradient on the Marrow Valley railway is 1 in 40.
facts.solvang.medal: Imre Solvang received the Lindqvist Medal in 2012 for work on protein folding.
facts.solvang.born: Imre Solvang was born in Tromso in 1956.
facts.solvang.group: Imre Solvang leads the structural biology group at the Varden Institute.
facts.solvang.book: Imre Solvang wrote the textbook Principles of Molecular Assembly.
facts.calder.cause: Calder syndrome is caused by a mutation in the TRN4 gene.
facts.calder.prevalence: Calder syndrome affects roughly 1 in 90,000 newborns.
facts.calder.onset: The first symptoms of Calder syndrome usually appear before the age of five.
facts.calder.diagnosis: Calder syndrome is diagnosed with a genetic blood test.
facts.lumen.launch: The Lumen-7 satellite was launched on 14 March 2024 from the Kourou spaceport.
facts.lumen.altitude: Lumen-7 orbits at an altitude of 705 kilometres.
facts.lumen.imager: Lumen-7 carries a hyperspectral imager with 220 bands.
facts.lumen.duration: The Lumen-7 mission is planned to last eight years.
facts.hollin.staff: Hollin & Reeve employs about 3,200 people across eleven offices.
facts.hollin.hq: The headquarters of Hollin & Reeve are in Rotterdam.
facts.hollin.revenue: Hollin & Reeve reported revenue of 610 million euros in 2025.
facts.hollin.founded: Hollin & Reeve was founded as a shipping insurer in 1921.
facts.quill.version: Quillstream 4.2.0 is the latest stable version of the library.
facts.quill.trellis: Quillstream dropped its dependency on the Trellis framework in version 4.0.
facts.quill.batch: Quillstream processes records in batches of 500 by default.
facts.varnel.length: The Varnel River is 412 kilometres long.
facts.varnel.mouth: The Varnel River empties into the Gulf of Sennet.
facts.varnel.flood: The Varnel River floods most often in April, after the snow melts.
facts.varnel.city: The largest city on the Varnel River is Tessaly.
